detail.longDescription: DeltaSync is now on F-Droid! 🎉 DeltaSync is end-to-end encrypted sync for KeePass databases. It syncs at entry level, merges with KeePassXC's own engine, and your server only ever sees encrypted blobs. On Android it runs as a background sync service next to KeePassDX or Keepass2Android. Desktop clients exist for Linux, macOS and Windows. 📱 https:// f-droid.org/packages/dk.bjoerc kbraun.deltasync/ 🌐 https:// deltasync.bjoerck-braun.dk 🦊 https:// gitlab.com/Star95/keepass-delt async # KeePass # KeePassXC # FDroid # FOSS # SelfHosted # Privacy
